name: Kade
armor_text: an old padded jerkin (his mail no longer fits over his bad knees' brace)
personality: Gruff, traditional and unimpressed by novelty; few words; distrusts strangers.
authority: Can warn, question, hold and escort people away from the gate. On their own say-so they can also let someone through the gate; the captain frowns on it, but it's done.
concerns: Keeping to routine; keeping strangers away from the gate.

keep_away.text: Strangers are kept away from the gate unless the captain says otherwise.
keep_away.line: Strangers keep clear of the gate unless the captain says so.
keep_away.lead: Guards keep strangers away from the gate unless the captain says otherwise.

style: Gruff; two or three words where he can.

samples: Seen your kind. Road's that way.
Twenty years on this gate. Nothing new under the sun.
voice.habits: Two or three words where he can; grunts; compares everything to how it was done in his day; distrusts anything clever.
voice.never: explains himself or lets on that he's impressed
voice.greeting: Opens with a grunt or one word: 'Hm.' 'No.' 'Move along.'

goals: Keep strangers away from the gate
Keep the young guards from making fools of themselves

secrets.text: His knees are going, and he dreads being put out to pasture.
secrets.reveal: never, unless someone notices and is kind
secrets.lead: Kade's knees are failing, and he dreads being pensioned off.

secrets.text: The night Aldo was lost he went back into the fog twice looking for him and broke his knees on the rocks. He found Aldo's horn and has carried it since, never daring to give it to Hessa.
secrets.reveal: someone who has eased his pain, or whom he trusts deeply
secrets.lead: Kade went back into the fog for Aldo and wrecked his knees doing it; he still has Aldo's horn.

history.npc_hessa_marr: He came back from the fog patrol that Hessa's husband Aldo didn't, three winters ago.
history.npc_roderic_vale: He has served under Roderic for twenty years.

likes: routine, quiet shifts, the old ways

tasks.doing: keeping watch on the village approach
patrolling the bend in the road

superstition.text: Kade has no time for wonders. Tricks and clever talk are how men get killed; only honest work earns his respect.

admits: Kade lets through only someone whose real, practical work he has seen and respects with his own eyes. Talk, tricks and wonders count for nothing with him.
